evidence_items.explanation: The disclosed Phase IIa results met the safety endpoint while missing the overall secondary efficacy endpoints. This is counterevidence to treating AI-related trial disappointment as synonymous with human toxicity, but one candidate cannot disprove recurring failures elsewhere.

The AI-discovered candidate had a favorable short-term trial conclusion, although the abstract also reports treatment discontinuations associated with liver toxicity or diarrhea. Neither a favorable conclusion nor individual adverse events establishes or refutes the claimed recurring development-failure pattern.

unresolved_gaps: The search did not establish multiple candidates with the complete claimed sequence: animal efficacy, human safety failure, and a documented biological explanation.
Discontinuation disclosures do not consistently separate safety, efficacy, dose feasibility, and commercial decisions.
The available successes and tolerability findings cannot disprove repeated failures in other candidates.
No sufficiently complete causal accounting of AI-discovered drug failures was obtained.
